name: What is included in kitchen finish carpentry?

mainEntity.name: What is included in kitchen finish carpentry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen finish carpentry includes the final, visible woodwork installed after structural framing, drywall, and primary utility rough-ins are done. In a kitchen remodel, this covers crown molding on upper cabinets, light rail molding, baseboards, window and door casing, cabinet end panels, toe kicks, and custom island trim. While rough carpentry forms the skeleton of the room, finish carpentry focuses on precision joints, clean reveals, and seamless transitions between factory cabinets and uneven drywall. Hiring a dedicated finish carpenter ensures that ceiling gaps, out-of-plumb walls, and cabinet alignments look clean and cohesive.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen finish carpentry includes crown molding, baseboards, cabinet trim, light rails, island paneling, toe kicks, and window or door casing.
